name: Krom'Grul
label: Quest
description: Krom'Grul: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My whole platoon was captured, friend. All were slain - except me.
Their leader, Krom'Grul, wanted to save me for some sort of ritual.

I was chained to this altar and brutalized by the beast. My physical being ceased functioning after an hour of this torture. The beast then ripped my wedding nose-ring off of my face and stuck it on his finger. I had never seen such savagery!
Find Krom'Grul and kill him! Take my ring back to Thal'trak.
And friend, tell him that we will meet again... In another life.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find Sha'ni? Is she ok?

clips.title: Completion
paras: We were going to move to the Hinterlands. Did she tell you? This was going to be her last mission.
I don't want it, friend. Keep it, throw it away, I don't care! The ring means nothing to me now. Not without her...
